note: fixed in v0.9.2 by normalizing the v prefix in gomod.Compare and Classify

every tool now registers through addTool, which recovers a panic, records a KindInternal fault with its stack, and returns INTERNAL_ERROR as an isError result; tested in internal/mcpserver/panic_internal_test.go
ecosystem.VersionNormalizer added; gomod implements it and PlanUpdates normalizes every decision's target, so an advisory fix reads v0.44.0
RunOnce now publishes through the configured forge when defaults.auto_pr is true, reporting the PR url or the local report path; tested in internal/app/autopr_test.go
v2eco.Berry reads a berry lockfile (__metadata, @npm: descriptors, multi-descriptor keys) with yarn up for apply; yarn v1 now declines berry files so the two never misread each other

ScanDependencies keeps one dependency per (target, name) and writes a target's snapshot once, so two workflow files pinning one action no longer become two changes; planner.Validate identifies a change by (target, dependency, version), so a plan for two go.mod files is no longer a duplicate either, while the same change twice for one target is still refused. rMath's plan now has 3 changes instead of 4 and applies; tested in internal/app/readpath_test.go, internal/app/writepath_test.go and internal/planner/planner_test.go

PlanUpdates stores an empty plan with an empty target row through firstTarget instead of indexing plan.Groups[0]; apply_plan then reports NOTHING_TO_APPLY. Tested in internal/app/readpath_empty_test.go

The hand-editing appliers now apply a planned change only to a line that still holds the plan's from-ref, and refuse the plan when a manifest holds anything else: actions, docker and maven return ecosystem.PlanMismatchError before writing, which the write path maps to PLAN_STALE. A ref that already holds the planned target counts as satisfied, so one plan still covers two workflow files. applyIntoWorktree additionally cross-checks every planned change against the ApplyResult (Observed, or a reason in the new ApplyResult.Skipped), so an applier that reports success without moving anything is refused too; maven reports its property-indirection and managed-version declines in Skipped and the commit says what did not land. Tested in internal/ecosystem/{actions,docker,maven} and internal/app/writepath_test.go; verified end to end against a clone of rMath: a plan stored against v4 refs applied to a branch now holding v7 fails with PLAN_STALE naming each ref, and re-planning then applying pins all three actions.

PlanUpdates returns registryUnavailable(...) when reg.Versions fails: REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE, or OFFLINE_CACHE_MISS when the error wraps httpcache.ErrOfflineCacheMiss (a sentinel added for this, previously the code existed but nothing produced it). Tested in internal/app/readpath_test.go
